benchmark.backend: explicit DirectX7.SOFTWARE + renderSoftware, frozen Tex3 CPU classes
benchmark.pipeline: clearDisplay -> transform/project shared vertices -> visibility/enqueue -> painter sort -> LightedPolygon3V -> TexturingPers/Affine -> flush/drawRGB
benchmark.texture: same opaque procedural64x64 checker, drawmode9, no mipmaps
benchmark.shading: P4 la221 becomes220 via original getLight255/256; P0 renderFast receives220 directly; CPU sampler rounding differs from M3G
benchmark.depth: painter: NO Z buffer; native POLY has depth ON; FILL native Z OFF
benchmark.alpha: opaque texels only; CPU nonzero sampling, not native threshold0.5
benchmark.projection: constant-depth full rectangle, integer screen grid; native subpixel/strip representation differs
benchmark.viewport: canvas width x (canvas height - 90), HUD excluded
benchmark.metrics: fractional FPS, R/software pipeline ms, C/drawRGB ms, I/frame interval; end-to-end Ktri/s or nominal Mpix/s
benchmark.small_resolution: grid > min(width,height) marked ERR, never count collapsed triangles
benchmark.failure_policy: manual lower/retry; auto OOM/ERR and skip, no alternative backend
benchmark.results: in-memory table/stdout, cleared on resize or P4/P0 toggle; not persisted after exit

purpose: Actual original Quantum software pipeline throughput, same nominal workloads as native PolyFill; NOT pixel-identical depth-equivalent rendering or a game FPS prediction.
